versions.content: User data shall be defined within empty space of the NmPdu If user data is defined it shall be located within the not already used bounds of the NmPdu , specifically user data shall: • not exceed NmPdu . length • not be defined in the location where CBV and/or Nid are defined ( nmCbvPosi- tion and nmNidPosition are configured • not be defined where the PncBitVector is located.
